limits: 100% of 14 costs county rows filled
Not yet applied to the ledger's hard costs, which are statewide.
BLS published construction pay for 6 of 14 counties; the statewide figure was withheld and is estimated from the published counties.

Average pay of construction jobs at private employers, by where the employer reports, not where it builds. A wage index is a proxy for local building costs; materials, land and fees are not in it. BLS withholds county figures that would reveal one employer; those counties take the state value.
